text: The ATM gave no cash, but two thousand rupees left your account.
RBI rules say a failed ATM withdrawal must be credited back within five days.
After that, your bank owes you a hundred rupees a day, without you asking.
Three days late? That's three hundred rupees, even at another bank's ATM.
Not back? Complain to your bank, and after thirty days, to the RBI Ombudsman.
